description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Sam The Concrete Man is hiring a junior developer to support its data team and franchise operations. The role focuses on SQL reporting, dashboards, web-based tools, data quality, and automations across business systems.
Junior Developer builds Azure SQL/Power BI reports, vendor portals, workflow automations, and maintains shared metrics and data quality.

Responsibilities:
• Write, test, and document SQL queries and views in Azure SQL
• Build and maintain reports, and troubleshoot refresh and connection problems
• Maintain our shared metric definitions file, and make sure Power BI measures, SQL views, and HTML dashboards all follow it
• Build and maintain web based portals for vendor interactions
• Check data quality by reconciling numbers between source systems, and our HTML dashboards, and flag mismatches
• Review the output of scheduled AI tasks, and fix the instructions when a number comes out wrong
• Set up, monitor, and fix automations in Power Automate and Make
• Help configure integrations and fields in HubSpot, Service Minder, and ClickUp
• Handle routine admin, such as user permission and group updates across franchise territories
• Document what you build so someone else can pick it up

Requirements:
• 2 years of experience or a 4-year degree in a relevant area of study
• Proficiency with SQL (think SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, filtering by date, etc.)
• Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
• Comfortability working in Excel
• Clear writing and the patience to explain technical things to non-technical coworkers

Preferred:
• Power BI or DAX
• Azure SQL or another cloud database
• HTML and JavaScript for simple web pages
• Experience writing clear instructions for AI assistants such as Claude, or writing in Markdown
• REST APIs and JSON
• Power Automate, Make, or Zapier
• HubSpot or another CRM
• Git basics
